digest: 过去 30 天，共追踪到 24 个热门 AI 开源项目（主力语言：Python, TypeScript, Rust）和 14 篇最新 ArXiv 论文。GitHub 最热方向是「其他热门」。

papers.summary_zh: 提出分组校准的在线策略蒸馏方法，修正长上下文推理中教师逐token指导的局部偏差，在全局约束任务上显著提升学生模型准确率与证据覆盖度

papers.title: Pre-Compiled Pipeline Shards for Distributed LLM Inference on Intel AI PC Fleets

papers.title: Open-MOPD: Diagnosing and Fixing Capability Imbalance in Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (M-OPD) has emerged as a promising paradigm for consolidating domain-specialized reinforcement learning (RL) experts into a single generalist student via dense, to
papers.summary_zh: 提出多教师同策略蒸馏能力失衡诊断框架，通过动态权重调节与梯度修正，在跨域任务中平均性能提升27%且训练稳定性显著增强

papers.title: Geometric Iterative Retrieval for Neural Audio Codec Resynthesis

papers.title: Grouping the Stochastic Machine: Precision, Not Capability, as the Frontier Metric for AI Systems

papers.title: Comment-level Topic Drift Analysis in the Reddit Corpus

papers.title: SPADE: Self-Play in Adaptive Synthetic Executable Environments

papers.summary_zh: 提出自博弈自适应合成可执行环境方法，动态生成多样化训练目标，使语言代理持续自我提升，性能较静态基线提升显著

papers.title: Beyond the Transcript: Detecting Covert Co ordination in Latent Multi-Agent Communication

papers.title: ChildSafeAds Shared Task 2026: Commercial Content in Child-Facing YouTube Videos
papers.abstract: ChildSafeAds is a shared task on commercial content in YouTube videos likely to reach children and teenagers. It contains 3,360 videos from 939 channels. Each instance begins with a segment submitted

papers.title: Continuous-Time Reinforcement Learning for Controlled Hawkes Jump-Diffusions

papers.summary_zh: 提出连续时间强化学习框架求解非马尔可夫霍克斯跳跃扩散控制问题，用路径依赖记忆建模突破经典随机控制局限，实现高维场景稳定收敛

papers.title: SCORE: Subject Coordinate Recovery for Label-Free Cross-Subject EEG-to-Image Retrieval
papers.abstract: Accurate visual decoding can reveal how the brain represents visual information and recover perceived content from neural signals such as electroencephalography (EEG), with potential for neural commun

papers.title: ADEPT: Accelerating Dexterity via Pre-Training and Post-Training using Reinforcement Learning
